subject.title: Add gated Claw publication and validation

question: Should ClawHub adopt this persistent Claw package and manifest contract now, with the schema, publication, read-gating, and deployment changes landed as one coordinated experimental rollout?
rationale: The PR creates a new stored package family, CLI publication mode, manifest language, dependency rules, and future migration obligation; tests cannot determine whether that is the permanent product contract maintainers want.

options.title: Approve coordinated experimental rollout
options.body: Approve the contract and merge only after the dependency and read-gating stack is complete and live lifecycle proof is attached.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the draft stack open without landing persistent storage or publication until the RFC settles the compatibility contract.

options.title: Narrow to validation only
options.body: Retain reusable local manifest validation while deferring server publication and persistence to a later approved stack.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated experimental rollout
recommendation.body: Approve the contract and merge only after the dependency and read-gating stack is complete and live lifecycle proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice concerns registry product scope and the long-lived package contract rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
